summary: Steel Aermotor tower on Ortega Mesa near Philmont, NM, listed as standing; a March 1950 fire destroyed the lookout's cabin and tower steps; build date unknown.

facts.design: 70-foot Aermotor open steel tower with 7x7 observation cab; ground residence cabin on site

access.note: On New Mexico State Trust Land. A new 2½-mile road, paid for by RMEF and reached under a 35-year lease to the New Mexico Department of Game and Fish, gives access to the land. The camping area at the road's start is open to licensed hunters in hunting season. Visitor access to the cab is not documented.

events.note: March 27, 1950 fire swept over the lookout point, destroying the cabin, tent, tools and tower steps, per a Clovis News Journal account quoted by Western Lookouts
RMEF-funded 2½-mile access road and 35-year right-of-way lease granted to the New Mexico Department of Game and Fish; RMEF article dated September 15, 2018
Registered July 7, 2022 as US 1653, NM 52; nominated by Brad Eells

notes_for_editor: Build date, builder and staffing appear in no source read; NHLR says construction date and use status are unknown. The 1950 fire rests on one passage quoting the Clovis News Journal on a Western Lookouts page; the newspaper original was not checked. NHLR names the New Mexico Forestry Division as administrator while RMEF says the land is state trust land under the State Lands Office; both are sourced and are not treated as a conflict. Record coordinates and elevation (2681.6 m) match NHLR (2,682 m) and the FFLA list. Record access 'unknown' can be replaced with the restricted level above after a human check. No corrections proposed.
